stories.headline: Rubio's four-day India visit: Modi, Jaishankar, Doval meetings; Trump calls in at US Embassy event; White House invitation extended to Modi
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio completed the first two days of a four-day India visit, meeting PM Modi (Saturday), EAM Jaishankar (Sunday) and NSA Doval (Sunday). Talks covered trade, energy security, defence co-production, US visa curbs, Iran war implications, counter-terrorism, and Quad coordination ahead of a foreign ministers' meeting on May 26. Trump called into the US Embassy's 250th Independence Day celebration on Sunday, lavishing praise on Modi and assuring India of full US support. Rubio extended a White House invitation to Modi on Trump's behalf.

stories.headline: Amit Shah addresses RSS-linked 'Janjati Mahakumbh' at Red Fort, assures tribals UCC will not apply to them and condemns forced conversion
stories.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah addressed a mass tribal gathering of an estimated 1.5 lakh people from 550-plus communities at the Red Fort grounds on May 24, organised by RSS-linked Janjati Suraksha Manch to mark the 150th birth anniversary of Birsa Munda. Shah assured tribal communities that the Uniform Civil Code will never apply to them, as it has not in BJP-ruled states Uttarakhand and Gujarat, and urged them not to believe 'misinformation' spread by 'divisive forces.' The event also pressed demands for de-listing converted Christians and Muslims from the Scheduled Tribe category.

stories.headline: Amit Shah announces 'Smart Border' technology grid against Pakistan and Bangladesh infiltration, pledges to deport all illegal migrants
stories.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah, speaking at the BSF Rustamji Memorial Lecture and in subsequent appearances, announced a technology-driven 'Smart Border Project' to make India's 6,000-km Pakistan and Bangladesh frontiers 'impenetrable' by next year, using drones, radars and cameras. He declared the government would identify and deport every infiltrator to prevent 'unnatural demographic changes,' and announced a forthcoming High-Power Demography Mission. Shah also visited Bikaner on May 25-26 to review border security and brief BSF jawans on the Pakistan frontier.

stories.headline: BJP sweeps West Bengal Falta repoll by record margin; new CM Adhikari consolidates power as Mamata Banerjee attacks 'bulldozer politics'
stories.summary: BJP candidate Debangshu Panda won the Falta Assembly repoll in West Bengal by over 1.09 lakh votes (149,666 to 40,645 for CPI-M), ending TMC's 15-year hold on the seat and strengthening the new BJP state government under CM Suvendu Adhikari. Mamata Banerjee, speaking via Facebook Live, alleged electoral irregularities and vowed continued resistance to the BJP government she described as practising 'bulldozer politics.' CM Adhikari had earlier visited Delhi to meet PM Modi, Amit Shah and President Murmu.

stories.headline: US drops all criminal fraud charges against Gautam Adani; Adani Group stocks rally as legal overhang clears
stories.summary: The Trump administration's Justice Department moved to permanently dismiss criminal bribery and fraud charges against Gautam Adani and associates, reportedly after Adani's team proposed a $10 billion US investment commitment. Adani Enterprises separately paid $275 million to settle Treasury/OFAC sanctions violations related to Iranian energy purchases. The SEC civil fraud case was also settled. Adani Group stocks jumped up to 5.3% on the news, and analysts said the clearing of legal risks could revive foreign institutional investment.

stories.headline: RBI defends rupee through aggressive interventions and record ₹2.86 lakh crore dividend transfer to government
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India intervened aggressively in forex markets to arrest the rupee's slide to successive record lows driven by Iran war-related oil price spikes and foreign fund outflows, deploying an estimated $18 billion in spot and forward interventions and announcing a $5 billion USD/INR buy-sell swap auction. The RBI simultaneously approved a record ₹2.86 lakh crore surplus transfer to the central government for FY26, prompting debate over whether the central bank is over-extending itself to support government finances.
